title: synchronized-microcohort-join-controller-with-graceful-failforward
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a controller to coordinate timeboxed micro-cohort joins for A/B experiments and canaries. Adds session-consistent join orchestration, new telemetry, and rollout guard checks. Backwards compatible with existing rollout policies.
description:
Context and motivation: We observed defects when promoting micro-cohorts to A/B variants where concurrent cohort joins could step on each other (session skew and transient mismatch of user splits). This PR adds a synchronized MicroCohort Join Controller that serializes cohort join work by session-lease and a staged commit protocol to ensure session-consistent join behavior across the mesh. The goal is to enable deterministic A/B join operations for small cohorts and staged canary promotions while preserving the existing rollback/failforward semantics used by the rollout runtime.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new controller component rollout/microcohort/controller.go implementing a lease-backed queue and a three-phase join protocol (prepare, validate, commit).
- Implements session affinity enforcement in rollout/microcohort/affinity.go to guarantee that sessions do not observe partial joins mid-transaction.
- Introduces a graceful failforward mode: if validation fails but the error is non-safety-critical (e.g., perf regression within tolerance), controller can mark cohort as degraded and reduce traffic fraction instead of immediate rollback.
- Adds new telemetry counters and histograms (microcohort.join.duration_ms, microcohort.join.validation_failures, microcohort.join.failforward_events) and tracing spans (join.prepare -> join.validate -> join.commit).
- Adds thorough unit and integration tests (tests/microcohort/*) and an e2e smoke harness to exercise session continuity under join and rollback scenarios.
- Updates docs runbooks and rollout design notes (docs/rollouts/microcohort-join.md).

Commits included:
- Add microcohort join controller and basic protocol (mch-controller init) — 4 commits aggregated: core controller + lease client wiring.
- Add session affinity enforcement and tests (affinity + tests).
- Add telemetry, tracing, and e2e smoke (telemetry + e2e).

Files changed (high level):
- rollout/microcohort/controller.go (new) — core orchestration logic.
- rollout/microcohort/affinity.go (new) — session stickiness checks and deterministic hashing helpers.
- rollout/registry/lease_client.go (small changes) — expose lease API used by controller.
- internal/telemetry/microcohort_metrics.go (new) — counters and histograms.
- tests/microcohort/ (new) — unit/integration harnesses, deterministic replay fixtures.
- docs/rollouts/microcohort-join.md (new) — design and operational runbook.
- pkg/api/rollout.proto (tweak) — optional enum for FailforwardMode.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests: added ~45 unit tests, focused on state transitions and race conditions.
- Integration: a 3-node integration harness simulates lease leader election and persistent state across controller restarts.
- E2E smoke: runs against dev cluster, validates session affinity across traffic split changes.
- CI: all checks passed after a lint fix and a test flake retry.

Rollout plan (ops):
- Feature gated behind rollout.experimental.microcohort_join=false by default.
- Gradual enablement: start with internal canaries (0.5% traffic) for 48h with telemetry alerting.
- Safety gates: validation failure rate > 0.5% or average join.duration_ms > configured SLO triggers an automatic traffic reduction or rollback depending on failforward policy.

Operational considerations:
- The controller holds short-lived leases per cohort; lease TTL defaults to 30s and is configurable. Watch for lease starvation in overloaded control planes; telemetry includes lease.acquire.duration_ms.
- Session affinity requires a deterministic hashing seed shared across routers; this PR adds a compatibility mode that falls back to current hashing when the seed is not available.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc and runbook updated.
- [x] Unit tests added and passing.
- [x] Integration and e2e smoke passing on dev cluster.
- [x] Telemetry and alerts wired to console dashboards.
- [x] Migration paths for older rollout specs documented.

Related work: ENG-3241 (design spike), ENG-3308 (affinity refactor), SUP-8821 (customer incident that motivated deterministic joins).

Notes for reviewers: Focus on race conditions in controller.go (prepared a small concurrency diagram in the doc), validation thresholds and the semantics of failforward versus rollback. There's a deliberate conservative default (failforward=false) to preserve existing rollback-first behavior.
review_comments:
Erik Johnson (2026-02-18): Overall design looks sound. Two immediate asks: (1) make lease TTL configurable via runtime config not a compile constant; (2) add a bounded retry backoff when leader fails to acquire lock to avoid hot-looping.

Maya Chen (2026-02-18): Done — pushed change to expose TTL via config and added jittered backoff in the leader acquisition path (see controller.go + tests).

Priya Nair (2026-02-20): Tests caught a race where session affinity seed could be nil during coordinator handoff. Can you add a fallback and unit test?

Maya Chen (2026-02-21): Added a compatibility fallback and new unit tests (tests/microcohort/affinity_fallback_test.go). Also added a note in docs about rolling upgrade ordering.

Owen Park (2026-02-23): Small nit on telemetry naming: prefer microcohort.join.validation_failures_total for prometheus style. Also, can we emit a debug span that includes cohort id for easier trace search?

Maya Chen (2026-02-24): Renamed metric to validation_failures_total and added cohort_id tag on debug span. Updated dashboards.
